interview.name: Tess
interview.answer: It’s now on Sunday at the community center.

reflections: Gus is seen as helpful and trusted because he offers tools to the community.
Tess acts as a connector, passing along useful information to others.
The repair drive has positive community participation and mutual support.
Tess is acting as a reliable organizer and amplifier for the repair drive, repeatedly spreading updates and needs to the group.
Gus is contributing practical support by offering tools, which helps the effort feel cooperative and resourceful.
The group appears coordinated around a community repair event with clear, shared logistics and ongoing supply gaps that Tess is helping communicate.
Tess is a proactive coordinator who keeps relaying repair-drive updates and supply needs to the group.
Opal and Tess are collaborating to track logistics, with Opal handling confirmation while Tess shares word-of-mouth outreach.
The group is aligned around practical support for the repair drive, especially the shortage of screws, duct tape, and flashlights.
Tess is the main information relay for the repair drive, and others rely on her to spread updates quickly.
The repair drive details were uncertain at first, but Rosa corrected the schedule and location, showing the group is actively coordinating and updating plans.
People are focused on practical contributions like tools and supplies, and Eli is waiting for final logistics before deciding how to attend.
Tess is the central coordinator, relaying updates and correcting changes for the group.
Eli, Mara, and Faye are all trying to plan around the event and depend on timely confirmation.
The event details shifted from Saturday at Uli's garage to Sunday at the community center, and the group is aligning around the new plan.
